title: Every Tube and DLR train in London in 24 hours
description:
Every Tube and DLR train running in London on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds. The feed has no London Overground, Elizabeth line or National Rail trains, so they are not shown.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside Greater London. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Northern, Piccadilly, District, Central, Victoria and DLR, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 496 Tube and DLR trains at 8:31 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
